about.title: We're reinventing the cruise industry
about.subtitle: CruiseSplit makes cruises flexible, affordable and spontaneously bookable

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.text: Cruises are a unique experience — but their full potential is still untapped. CruiseSplit complements cruise lines' existing offerings: we make individual segments bookable and together open up new audiences. A win-win partnership — more reach for cruise lines, more flexibility for travellers.

problem.heading: The problem

agb.heading: General Terms and Conditions
agb.s1Body: These General Terms and Conditions apply to all bookings made through the CruiseSplit platform (cruisesplit.de), operated by Patrizia Kröger, Cologne. By booking a segment, the user accepts these terms.
agb.s2Body: CruiseSplit is a booking platform for individual cruise segments. CruiseSplit brokers bookings between travellers and cruise lines. CruiseSplit is not itself a tour operator within the meaning of travel-contract law, but acts as an intermediary.
agb.s3Body: By submitting a booking, the user makes a binding offer. The contract is concluded once the booking confirmation is received by email. During the beta phase, bookings are confirmed manually. The user is informed by email about the status of their booking.
agb.s4Body: All prices shown are final prices per person in Euros incl. statutory VAT. Payment is due at the time of booking. In the current beta phase, payment details are communicated by email after a booking is received.
agb.s5Body: Free cancellation is possible up to 48 hours before departure. For cancellations less than 48 hours before departure, a cancellation fee of 50% of the booking price applies. Cancellations should be sent by email to patrizia.kroeger@gmx.com.
agb.s6Body: CruiseSplit is not liable for services provided by cruise lines, delays, cancellations or any other circumstances outside CruiseSplit's sphere of influence. Liability is limited to intent and gross negligence.
agb.s7Body: Personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
agb.s8Body: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies. Place of jurisdiction is Cologne.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to personally identify you.
privacy.s2Body:
CruiseSplit, represented by Patrizia Kröger
Cologne, Germany
Email: patrizia.kroeger@gmx.com
privacy.s3CookiesBody: Our website uses cookies. These are small text files that your web browser stores on your device. Cookies help us make our service more user-friendly, effective and secure.
privacy.s3LogsBody: The provider of these pages automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser transmits to us automatically. These are: browser type and version, operating system used, referrer URL, hostname of the accessing computer, time of server request and IP address.
privacy.s3BookingBody: When you make a booking, we collect the data you enter (name, date of birth, email address, passport number) in order to process the booking. This data is used exclusively to process your booking and is not passed on to third parties, except to the respective cruise line in order to carry out the trip.
privacy.s4Body: You have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients and the purpose of data processing, as well as the right to correction or deletion of this data. For this and for further questions on the subject of personal data, you can contact us at any time at the address given in the imprint.
privacy.s5Body: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 Pine Street Suite 701, San Francisco, California 94104, USA. Further information can be found in Vercel's Privacy Policy: https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy
privacy.s6Body: Bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before departure. To exercise the right of withdrawal, please contact: patrizia.kroeger@gmx.com
